title: Corporate Governance
completion_message: ¡Excelente! El Gobierno Corporativo es el nivel más alto de toma de decisiones en una empresa. Entender términos como 'fiduciary duty' o 'golden parachute' te permite comprender la política y el poder en las altas esferas corporativas.

parts.visual:
La Junta Directiva (Board of Directors): 
- Board of Directors (Junta Directiva / El comité elegido que representa a los accionistas). 
Ej: The Board of Directors fired the CEO yesterday. 
- Chairman / Chairperson (Presidente de la junta). 
Ej: The Chairperson called the meeting to order. 
- Shareholder / Stockholder (Accionista / Dueño de acciones). 
Ej: The shareholders voted against the new compensation package.
parts.audio: The Board of Directors. The 'Board of Directors' is an elected group of individuals that represents shareholders. For example: The Board of Directors fired the CEO yesterday. The 'Chairman' or 'Chairperson' is the head of the board. For example: The Chairperson called the meeting to order. A 'Shareholder' or 'Stockholder' is an owner of shares in a company. For example: The shareholders voted against the new compensation package.

parts.visual:
Deberes y Compensaciones Directivas: 
- Fiduciary duty (Deber fiduciario / Obligación legal de actuar en el mejor interés económico de la empresa). 
Ej: Board members have a fiduciary duty to the shareholders. 
- Golden parachute (Paracaídas dorado / Acuerdo financiero muy lucrativo para un ejecutivo en caso de despido). 
Ej: The CEO left the failing company with a $20 million golden parachute. 
- Conflict of interest (Conflicto de intereses). 
Ej: Hiring his own brother's firm was a clear conflict of interest.
parts.audio: Executive Duties and Compensation. 'Fiduciary duty' is the legal obligation of one party to act in the best interest of another. For example: Board members have a fiduciary duty to the shareholders. A 'Golden parachute' is a huge severance package guaranteed to a company executive if they are fired. For example: The CEO left the failing company with a $20 million golden parachute. A 'Conflict of interest' occurs when an individual's personal interests could compromise their professional judgment. For example: Hiring his own brother's firm was a clear conflict of interest.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige el término de gobierno corporativo correcto.

questions.question: The group of people elected by shareholders to manage a company is the ____ of Directors.
questions.explanation: Board of Directors = junta directiva / consejo de administración.

questions.question: The person who presides over the meetings of the Board of Directors is the ____.
questions.explanation: Chairman (o Chairperson) = presidente de la junta directiva.

questions.question: An individual or institution that legally owns one or more shares of stock in a public or private corporation is a ____. (Accionista).
Anyone who has an interest or concern in an organization (employees, customers, suppliers) is a ____. (Parte interesada).
questions.explanation: Stakeholder = cualquier parte interesada (más amplio que shareholder).

questions.question: A legal obligation of one party to act in the best interest of another is a ____ duty. (Deber fiduciario).
A large payment or other financial compensation guaranteed to a company executive should they be dismissed is a golden ____. (Paracaídas dorado).
questions.explanation: Golden parachute = indemnización millonaria por despido para ejecutivos.

questions.question: When a person's private interests interfere with their professional responsibilities, it is a ____ of interest.
questions.explanation: Conflict of interest = conflicto de intereses.

questions.question: The system of rules, practices, and processes by which a company is directed and controlled is corporate ____. (Gobierno corporativo).
A person who is on the board of directors but does not work for the company on a daily basis is an independent or non-____ director.
questions.explanation: Non-executive director (o independent director) = consejero externo / independiente.

questions.question: When one company attempts to buy out another against the wishes of the target company's management, it is a ____ takeover. (OPA hostil).
questions.explanation: Hostile takeover = toma de control (adquisición) hostil.

questions.question: A strategy used by a target company to prevent a hostile takeover (e.g., making the stock less attractive) is a ____ pill. (Píldora envenenada).
A voting method where a shareholder grants another person the authority to vote on their behalf is a ____ vote. (Voto por poder).
questions.explanation: Proxy vote = voto por delegación / poder.

questions.question: The yearly meeting where shareholders vote on company issues and elect the board is the ____ (Annual General Meeting).
questions.explanation: AGM = Annual General Meeting (Junta General de Accionistas).

questions.question: The minimum number of board members required to be present to make the proceedings of a meeting valid is a ____. (Quórum).
A formal decision made by a board or meeting, usually after a vote, is a ____. (Resolución).
questions.explanation: Resolution = resolución / acuerdo formal de la junta.

questions.question: When a board member formally agrees with a proposal during a meeting, they ____ the motion. (Apoyar/Secundar).
questions.explanation: To second a motion = secundar una moción.

questions.question: A complete record of the discussions and decisions made during a meeting are called the ____. (Actas).
questions.explanation: Meeting minutes = actas de la reunión.

questions.question: The list of items to be discussed at a formal meeting is the ____. (Agenda / Orden del día).
When a board member abstains from voting due to a conflict of interest, they ____ themselves. (Recusarse).
questions.explanation: To recuse oneself = recusarse (abstenerse por conflicto de intereses).

questions.question: An attempt by activist shareholders to join together to win a corporate vote and replace management is a ____ fight. (Guerra de poderes).
questions.explanation: Proxy fight = guerra de delegación de votos para cambiar la directiva.
